title: Segata Sanshirou: Shinken Yuugi
native_title: せがた 三四郎 ～真剣遊戯～
overview:
Play! Until your fingers break!!

What is true play!? What is the wonder of accomplishment!? I'll teach you that myself!!

Master it! The secrets of play!! Ten training trials for mastering play (mini-games), a collection of TV and radio commercials for mastering Segata Sanshiro, unreleased movies, and much more play included.

遊べっ！指が折れるまでっ!!

真の遊びとは!?成し遂げるすばらしさとは!?そいつを俺が教えてやろうっ!!

極めろ！遊びの極意!!遊びを極める十の修行（ミニゲーム）、せがた三四郎を極めるTV・ラジオCM集、そして未公開ムービーなど、遊戯を多数収録。
